title: The History of Poverty in China
description: An educational exploration of the historical context and current status of poverty in China, suitable for Pre-GCSE students.

scenes.script: Explore the landscapes of rural China, where poverty has shaped the lives of many families throughout history.
scenes.prompt: A panoramic view of rural China, showcasing traditional Chinese houses and rice fields, with local farmers working in the fields, under a bright blue sky, capturing the essence of rural life.

scenes.script: China has seen a significant reduction in extreme poverty over the past few decades.
Meet families in rural China as they discuss the impact of economic reforms on their lives and communities.
scenes.prompt: Intimate interviews with families in a Chinese village, showing their daily routines, children playing, and parents discussing the changes in their lives due to economic growth, in a warm, inviting atmosphere.

scenes.script: The GDP growth in China has played a crucial role in reducing poverty levels.
